integrity: The proof derives all feasible FAT parameters from the degree-two local equations before classifying cyclic patterns. The verifier independently evaluates the defining neighborhood equations and the refinement order with exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to cycle graphs and does not classify FAT colorings of arbitrary maximum-degree-two graphs.
The finite checker covers orders three through twelve; the all-orders statement is proved analytically.
The originality assessment is literature-based and cannot exclude poorly indexed or concurrent independent work.
title: Complete irreducible FAT coloring classification for cycle graphs
